page_title: Medal for the Expedition Against Adil Bey in 1867
source_text: Medal for the Expedition Against Adil Bey in 1867 Médaille commémorative de l’expédition contre l’insurrection d’Adel Bey. 1867 Medal instituted by Muhammad as-Sadiq Pasha-Bey in 1868. Medal awarded to recognise the services of those who took part in the military expedition led by the Bey al-Mahalla and General H.E. Ahmad Zaroou to Kabylie in order to suppress the rebellion headed by Prince Sidi Muhammad al-Adil Bey in 1865-1867. Medal have two classes. Ottoman Tunisia
